errors.evidence: Multiple category names from the x-axis are incorrectly transcribed. The correct names are: “名词” (not “名喻”), “动词” (not “幻词”), “直接夸张” (not “直接喻称”), “间接夸张” (not “间接喻称”), “融合夸张” (not “整合喻称”), “成分排比” (not “成分排序”), and “句子排比” (not “句子排序”).

The list of categories with an F1 score of 0 is incorrect and incomplete. The categories with an F1 score of 0 are “名词”, “形容词”, “副词”, and “融合夸张”. The description incorrectly uses the names “名喻” and “整合喻称” and omits “副词” from the list.

The label for the left y-axis is not explicitly stated on the axis itself. The legend indicates that the blue bars represent '总数' (Total Count). The description uses '训练集数量' (training set quantity), which is an interpretation from the figure's external caption, not a direct description of the chart's labels.
The legend entry for the orange line is 'F1-socre'. The description provides the corrected and translated term 'F1分数' (F1 score) instead of reporting the text as written in the legend.
